name: agri-shield

scripts.clean: turbo clean && find . -name 'node_modules' -type d -prune -exec rm -rf '{}' + 2>/dev/null; true
scripts.db:rls: docker exec -i agri-shield-postgres psql -v ON_ERROR_STOP=1 -U agrishield -d agrishield < scripts/rls-policies.sql
scripts.db:setup: pnpm db:up && pnpm db:migrate && pnpm db:rls && pnpm db:seed

description: AI-powered climate decision intelligence for farmers, governments and supply chains across Asia
author: Nitya Prakash Pandey
